description: 火焰兵（flamer）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 火焰兵

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a flamethrower trooper, stocky and broad, about six heads tall: a thick brown-orange fire-resistant armored suit, a round full helmet with a small orange visor, a heavy chest plate, big shoulder pauldron, forearm guards and knee pads, black rubber boots, thick gloves, orange neon lines. Nothing is carried on the back: no backpack, no fuel tank, no hose.
